features.name: BC Copilot for item description generation
features.description: The BC copilot automatically generates item copy and descriptions based on existing copy already written in the system, eliminating the need for manual text entry for new inventory items.

features.name: BC Sales Agent
features.description: An AI agent integrated into Business Central that provides inbox copilot and AI capabilities for sales-related tasks, mentioned as one of the first places in the BizApps world to get this functionality.

features.name: Copilot Studio integration
features.description: Business Central can now connect with Copilot Studio to enable chatbots on websites that pull data from BC, expanding the connectivity with other Microsoft ecosystem products.

features.name: Adaptive UX based on AI interaction
features.description: Future evolution where the user experience in Business Central will adjust dynamically based on user interactions, such as different starting points for uploading versus viewing items, making processes more efficient.
